_note: Realistic characters (character/Cast.ts, docs/characters.md). Paths are relative to this folder. 'clips': animation clips by name - a glb (a skeleton and one animation, retargeted at load onto each model's rig), or {file, range: [s0, s1], speed, loop (default true), anchor: 'start'|'end' (the hips' travel pinned where they are at that end)}. 'actions': which clip a gait action plays ('locomotion' = idle/walk/run by speed), or {clip, legs: 'gait'} (the gait's pelvis and legs under the clip's upper body); consecutive actions on one clip carry on (knocked then down: the fall holds its last frame lying); an action not listed keeps the procedural gait. A character may override 'clips' or 'actions'. hairColor (optional) multiplies the hair's colour; each character's colours are baked into its textures by scripts/characters/pack.mjs from the `look` in scripts/characters/cast.json. Mixamo's Sitting Idle leans back into a chair's back; 'sit' is its Sitting (upright, hands on knees); drink and chess keep the gait (the cup, the pieces). Fight (2026-10-13, Mixamo): guard/jab/cross/hook/block/flinch keep the gait's legs (they step and lunge); uppercut and kick are whole-body; each blow's clip is cut and sped up so it lands at character/Animator.ts STRIKE[k].hit (a little after the fist's or foot's fastest frame, .scratch/sweep/animmeasure.test.ts: the hook sweeps across and the uppercut rises past its blow, so 'furthest out' misread both); flinch picks the head or the stomach hit. The guard is the jab clip's opening pose held (fists by the chin); Mixamo's Fight Idle holds both hands out in front, MMA style, and is the Black Panther thugs' guard instead (a brawler's look, and the two sides read apart).
